data_provenance: SSC CGL Tier 1 pattern as reported by PhysicsWallah/Adda247/Testbook (Sep 2026): 100 Q / 200 marks / 60 minutes — 4×25Q sections (Reasoning, GA, Quant, English), +2/−0.50. Confirm against ssc.gov.in before production use.
important_caveat: Tier 1 is qualifying only (does not count toward final merit). 2026 trackers report possible 15-min sectional timing — verify against the live notification.

exam_day.note: Single CBT. Four sections of 25 questions / 50 marks each. Overall 60 minutes (possible 15-min sectional timing in 2026).

Paper_1.label: SSC CGL Tier 1
Paper_1.overall_difficulty: Moderate; Geometry/Trigonometry and non-verbal reasoning skew harder

section_1_single_correct.note: SSC CGL Tier 1 is 5-option single-correct MCQ only. Four equal sections of 25Q in all_subjects_table.

marking.note: No official sectional cut-offs in Tier 1; overall category-wise cut-off only. Tier 1 does not count toward final merit.

question_types_note: SSC CGL Tier 1 uses only 5-option single-correct MCQ. No multi-correct, numerical entry, or match-list.
